pins.issue: Design assumes pin 1 = cell + (CELL_P, to VBAT through JP5). PicoBlade has no standard battery polarity: vendors wire red to either pin. Board relies on J2 silk "+" and the pack check in docs/assembly.md / bringup.md step 0 (a reversed cell destroys the TP4056). 1.0 A per contact against at most about 0.4 A (charge 0.33-0.36 A, play less).
